description: This file defines the Vtiger_DependencyPicklist class, which manages dependent picklist fields in the vtiger CRM system, including retrieving, saving, deleting dependencies, and generating dependency data sources.

classes.name: Vtiger_DependencyPicklist
classes.description: Class for managing dependent picklist fields and their dependencies in vtiger CRM.

methods.name: getDependentPicklistFields
methods.description: Retrieves dependent picklist fields for a given module.

methods.name: getAvailablePicklists
methods.description: Fetches available picklist fields for a module.

methods.name: savePickListDependencies
methods.description: Saves dependencies between picklist fields for a module.

methods.name: deletePickListDependencies
methods.description: Deletes dependencies between specified picklist fields.

methods.name: getPickListDependency
methods.description: Retrieves dependency mapping for specific picklist fields.

methods.name: getPicklistDependencyDatasource
methods.description: Generates data source for picklist dependencies.

methods.name: getJSPicklistDependencyDatasource
methods.description: Returns JSON-encoded data source for picklist dependencies.

methods.name: checkCyclicDependency
methods.description: Checks for cyclic dependencies among picklist fields.

methods.name: getDependentPickListModules
methods.description: Retrieves modules with dependent picklist fields.
